prompt_md: What has 13 hearts, yet not a single one of them beats?
prompt_short: What has 13 hearts, yet not a single one of them beats?
explain_intuition_md: Hearts that grow make you think of artichokes and lettuce, but the count gives it away: a deck of cards has exactly 13 hearts, and none of them has a pulse.
explain_math_md: A deck has 4 suits of 13 cards, so $52 / 4 = 13$ hearts.
